grammar.numbers: tear-off stub: gold counterfoil, the number counting up (years and dates as said), a stat's label; a second number while the stage is taken becomes a small stub in the top band
grammar.comparisons: two thermal receipts rise from the printer: BEFORE prints first, AFTER beside it, each row as said, totals bold under a double rule, the reel's question as the footer; a gold difference stamp thumps on only when both totals are numbers in the same unit
grammar.steps: itemised receipt: each item prints in spoken order with a gold tick
grammar.change: one receipt: old total struck through by a pen (red/green only from tone or direction, else gold), new total printed below with a direction chevron when the data gives one
grammar.trend: classic line graph (MotionTrack), printer steps aside
grammar.banks: printed slip with the logo on white and a neutral label
grammar.captionPosition: dark strip under the printer while something prints; while the stage is free the words print on a paper slip out of the printer; English line on SAFE.bottom

skinAxes.cover: logo tile on white, the title printed on a receipt (keywords on a gold highlighter) rising out of the printer
skinAxes.captions: bold white on a dark strip, keywords gold, current word underlined gold; or dark type on a paper slip
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics, no footage: dark navy counter-top with a warm lamp pool
skinAxes.transitions: paper feeds out line by line with printer jitter, tear-off, stamp thump, pen strike
skinAxes.texture: brushed stone grain, thermal paper with zig-zag torn edges, dotted leaders, tabular numbers
skinAxes.sound: voice + print clicks per row, whip on the strike, a thump on the stamp
skinAxes.cta: white contact card + compliance card (classic outro)
